capabilities: Convert Dataview queries to Bases blocks
Scan the vault for convertible queries
extras: Conversions are the only edits, each is one undo step, and the original query is kept in a hidden comment; no network use and Dataview need not be installed.
intentEvidence: A migration helper for people moving off Dataview, which has had no release in over a year,
motivation: Dataview has had no release in over a year, so users moving to the Bases core feature need help converting their queries.
problem: Dataview is unmaintained and Bases reads only frontmatter properties, so there is no built-in way to move queries and inline fields over.

relations.evidence: A migration helper for people moving off Dataview

summary: Migration helper that converts Dataview queries into Bases blocks, moves inline fields into properties, and reports which queries can convert.
